# Adversary-in-the-middle

**AitM** (historically MITM) techniques position an attacker between parties to intercept or alter communications. On local networks this often includes ARP cache poisoning; on higher layers it includes rogue proxies, evil twin Wi‑Fi, and some phishing kit patterns.

Always scope investigations to **authorized** networks and assets.
